items.name: created
items.title: Parcel created.
items.description: Parcel created, but not ready for shipment.

items.name: offers_prepared
items.title: Offers are prepared.
items.description: Offers for the parcel are prepared.

items.name: offer_selected
items.title: Offer selected.
items.description: The client chose one of the proposed offers.

items.name: confirmed
items.title: Prepared by the Sender.
items.description: The parcel will soon be handed over to us to reach you as quickly as possible.

items.name: dispatched_by_sender
items.title: Parcel shipped at the parcel machine.
items.description: The parcel is waiting for the delivery man to take it out of the parcel machine. From there it will go to the nearest InPost branch and then to the collection parcel machine.

items.name: collected_from_sender
items.title: Picked up from the client.
items.description: Courier collected the parcel from the Sender and passes it to the InPost branch.

items.name: taken_by_courier
items.title: Picked up from Sender.
items.description: The parcel was received from the Sender and set off on its way.

items.name: adopted_at_source_branch
items.title: Parcel in the warehouse.
items.description: Your parcel has been received at one of our logistics centres, from where it soon will continue its journey.

items.name: sent_from_source_branch
items.title: On the road.
items.description: Your parcel is on its way to the next intermediate hub.

items.name: ready_to_pickup_from_pok
items.title: It's waiting to be collected at the Parcel Service Point.
items.description: Please collect your parcel from the InPost Point within 3 days.

items.name: ready_to_pickup_from_pok_registered
items.title: It's waiting to be collected at the Customer Service Point.
items.description: Please collect your parcel from the InPost Point within 3 days. Address.

items.name: oversized
items.title: Oversize parcel.
items.description: The parcel does not fit into the locker of the parcel machine.

items.name: adopted_at_sorting_center
items.title: Parcel waiting for transferring.
items.description: The parcel is waiting to be transferred to the destination town. Most InPost parcels stop at the Main Sorting Facility for a while. Up to one million parcels per day are sorted in the state-of-the-art warehouse!

items.name: sent_from_sorting_center
items.title: Sent from the Sorting Facility.
items.description: The parcel is going to the Recipient's town.

items.name: adopted_at_target_branch
items.title: The parcel is in town.
items.description: The parcel is already in the Recipient's town. Soon it will reach the hands of the delivery man and begin the final leg of the journey.

items.name: out_for_delivery
items.title: Handed over for delivery.
items.description: The shipment will reach the Recipient on the next working day at the latest. InPost delivery men deliver parcels even late in the evening, so it is worth having your phone on.

items.name: ready_to_pickup
items.title: Placed in the (collection) parcel machine.
items.description: It’s done! The parcel will wait for the collection in the Parcel Machine. The Receiver gets a notification in the application, a text message and an e-mail with the collection code. If the parcel is not collected within this time, it will be returned to the Sender, which will be notified to the Receiver in a separate communication.

items.name: pickup_reminder_sent
items.title: Reminder of a pending parcel.
items.description: You still have 12 hours to collect the parcel from the parcel machine. Then it will be returned to the Sender. Do you want to extend the stay of your parcel for a fee? Do it in InPost App. Read about it on our website https://inpost.pl/przedluzenie-czasu-odbioru-paczki

items.name: delivered
items.title: Delivered.
items.description: The journey of the parcel from the Sender to the Recipient has ended, but it does not have to mean the end of our acquaintance:) If you like InPost, visit our fanpage on Facebook. Thank you!

items.name: pickup_time_expired
items.title: The deadline for collecting has passed.
items.description: The time for you to collect the parcel from the parcel machine has passed. InPost delivery man will take the parcel to your branch at the next visit to the parcel machine. The Recipient still has a chance to collect the parcel if he arrives at the parcel machine before the delivery man.

items.name: avizo
items.title: Back to the branch.
items.description: The parcel is returned to the InPost branch. In a text message and e-mail, we informed the Recipient of the date and time of its collection.

items.name: claimed
items.title: Complained in Parcel Machine.
items.description: Please complete the complaint process by filling out the form on the InPost website.

items.name: returned_to_sender
items.title: Return to sender.
items.description: The parcel has set off on its way back to the Sender.

items.name: canceled
items.title: The label was cancelled.
items.description: The shipping label has been canceled or expired. The parcel has not been sent to the Recipient.

items.name: other
items.title: Other status.
items.description: The parcel is in an unrecognized status.

items.name: dispatched_by_sender_to_pok
items.title: Shipped at the Customer Service Point.
items.description: The Sender handed the parcel over to an employee of InPost point. This is where her journey to the Recipient begins.

items.name: out_for_delivery_to_address
items.title: In delivery.
items.description: The parcel is already on the last stage of its journey - it has been handed over to a courier for delivery to the indicated address.

items.name: pickup_reminder_sent_address
items.title: In delivery.
items.description: InPost courier did not find the Recipient at the indicated address.

items.name: rejected_by_receiver
items.title: Parcel rejection.
items.description: The Recipient has refused to accept the parcel.

items.name: undelivered_wrong_address
items.title: No delivery possible.
items.description: No delivery possible today. Reason: incorrect address details.

items.name: undelivered_incomplete_address
items.title: No delivery possible.
items.description: No delivery possible today. Reason: incomplete address information.

items.name: undelivered_unknown_receiver
items.title: No delivery possible.
items.description: No delivery possible today. Reason: Recipient unknown.

items.name: undelivered_cod_cash_receiver
items.title: No delivery possible.
items.description: No delivery possible today - Recipient did not have cash to pay for the amount of the collection.

items.name: taken_by_courier_from_pok
items.title: On the way to the InPost shipping branch.
items.description: An InPost delivery man collected the parcel shipped at the Customer Service Point and will forward it to an InPost branch, from where it will be sent further.

items.name: undelivered
items.title: Transfer of undeliverable parcels to the warehouse.
items.description: Transfer of undeliverable parcels to the warehouse.

items.name: return_pickup_confirmation_to_sender
items.title: Return documents have been prepared.
items.description: The parcel has been collected. The Return Receipt has been sent to the Sender.

items.name: ready_to_pickup_from_branch
items.title: Parcel not collected - waiting in the Branch.
items.description: The parcel has arrived at an InPost branch. In a text message and e-mail, we informed the Recipient of the date and time of its collection.

items.name: delay_in_delivery
items.title: Possible delay in delivery.
items.description: Delivery will be delayed - our sincerest apologies. In subsequent messages, we will inform the Recipient of the new delivery date.

items.name: redirect_to_box
items.title: Rerouted to parcel machine.
items.description: The Recipient of this courier parcel used the free option of dynamic rerouting to the InPost parcel machine. Once the parcel is delivered to the selected machine, the Recipient will receive an e-mail/SMS message containing the details needed to receive the parcel.

items.name: canceled_redirect_to_box
items.title: Rerouting cancelled.
items.description: Rerouting this courier parcel to an InPost parcel machine turned out to be impossible due to its excessive size. The parcel will be delivered to the Recipient at the address indicated in the order.

items.name: readdressed
items.title: Rerouted to another address.
items.description: The courier parcel was rerouted to another address free of charge at the request of the Recipient.

items.name: undelivered_no_mailbox
items.title: No delivery possible.
items.description: No delivery possible today. Reason: no mailbox.

items.name: undelivered_not_live_address
items.title: No delivery possible.
items.description: No delivery possible today. Reason: The Recipient does not live at the address indicated.

items.name: undelivered_lack_of_access_letterbox
items.title: No delivery possible.
items.description: The parcel has set off on its way back to the Sender.

items.name: missing
items.title: translation missing: en_GB.statuses.missing.title
items.description: translation missing: en_GB.statuses.missing.description

items.name: stack_in_customer_service_point
items.title: Parcel stored at Parcel Service Point.
items.description: Click and learn more about parcel storage at Parcel Service Points. https://inpost.pl/pomoc-czym-jest-magazynowanie-paczek-w-pop

items.name: stack_parcel_pickup_time_expired
items.title: The deadline for collecting the stored parcel has passed.
items.description: The deadline for collecting the parcel from the Parcel Service Point has passed, but the parcel is still stored there - it is waiting for the courier to come and take it to the parcel machine.

items.name: unstack_from_customer_service_point
items.title: On the way to the parcel machine of your choice.
items.description: The courier is carrying your parcel to a parcel machine.

items.name: courier_avizo_in_customer_service_point
items.title: Awaiting collection.
items.description: The parcel was advised at the Parcel Service Point. If you don't collect it within three business days, it will go back to the Sender.

items.name: taken_by_courier_from_customer_service_point
items.title: Returned to sender.
items.description: The time for you to collect the parcel has passed. It has been picked up by a courier from the Parcel Service Point and will soon be on its way back to the Sender.

items.name: stack_in_box_machine
items.title: Parcel stored in temporary parcel machine
items.description: Click and find out more about storing parcels in temporary parcel machines: https://inpost.pl/pomoc-czym-jest-magazynowanie-paczek-w-paczkomatach-tymczasowych

items.name: unstack_from_box_machine
items.title: The deadline for collecting the stored parcel has passed
items.description: The deadline for collecting the parcel from the temporary parcel machine has passed, but the parcel is still stored there - it is waiting for the courier to come and take it to the originally selected parcel machine.

items.name: stack_parcel_in_box_machine_pickup_time_expired
items.title: The deadline for collecting the stored parcel has passed
items.description: The deadline for collecting the parcel from the temporary parcel machine has passed, but the parcel is still stored there - it is waiting for the courier to come and take it to the originally selected parcel machine.
